t.O que é um cartão de avaliação Google co: What is a Google review card with NFC?

Filtrar clientes para que só os sat: No. Filtering customers so only happy ones leave reviews is called review gating, and it's prohibited by Google's policies — Google can remove reviews and even suspend the business profile.
